short_description: Biofeedback-based video game platform for children ages 6-14 that teaches emotional regulation skills through heart rate monitoring and interactive gameplay.
long_description: Mightier is a digital biofeedback-based neurotechnology developed from research at Boston Children's Hospital and Harvard Medical School. Designed for children ages 6-14 navigating autism, ADHD, anxiety, anger, and ODD, the platform uses 30+ engaging video games paired with a Bluetooth heart rate sensor to teach emotional regulation in real time. When a child's heart rate increases (signaling stress or frustration), the games become harder, encouraging kids to practice calming techniques to regain control. After 3 months of use, 84% of parents report improvements in anger, frustration, or aggressive behaviors, and 71% report improvements in impulsivity and/or hyperactivity.

faqs.a: Mightier is a biofeedback-based video game platform for children ages 6-14 that teaches emotional regulation using a heart rate sensor and 30+ interactive games developed from research at Boston Children's Hospital.

Children wear a Bluetooth heart rate sensor while playing games. When their heart rate increases from stress or frustration, games become harder, encouraging them to practice calming techniques to regain control and continue playing.

faqs.q: What results can families expect from Mightier?
faqs.a: After 3 months, 84% of parents report improvements in anger, frustration, or aggressive behaviors, and 71% report improvements in impulsivity and/or hyperactivity.
Mightier costs $28-$40 per month with a 90-day money-back guarantee. It is HSA/FSA eligible.
